notes.title: Release Window, New Publisher, Next Fest Demo
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Three years ago, we launched our first ever title as a studio with ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree. It was received with critical acclaim and won several awards, and we were so humbled by all the support and love for the unique Norse world we created.

Now, we have several announcements to share with you all! 

New Publisher
First up, we're happy to share that we have an official publisher: Untold Tales! They've been a great partner and will support us in all efforts to bring our game to you as smoothly as possible. So go on and give them a follow! -> https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/untoldtales

Release Window
Second, we're excited to confirm that we're targeting launch in early 2023. We understand that it's not an exact date, but game development can fluctuate wildly and we don't want to promise something only to disappoint! AND, we'll also be launching on Nintendo Switch, so you can find us there if that's more your style.

Next Fest Demo Available Now
Last but certainly not least, we have a free demo for you to try as part of Next Fest! That's right, it's available now. So keep that axe sharp, you'll need it! And when you're done playing, come back and give us your thoughts. We'd love to hear them!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/894620

If you enjoyed what you played, please wishlist and spread the word, as that helps immensely to increase awareness. Be sure to follow our social channels below for all news and future updates on ATONE.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/UntoldTalesHQ
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/untoldtalesgames
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@untoldtaleshq

Cheers!
Wildboy Studios and Untold Tales
